author: bshastry
content: Other clients have limited amplification due to bounded queues/caches for envelopes with unknown beacon root

author: potuz
content: yes Gloas has made a mess of caches of objects that we need to keep for gossip validation without being able to validate them early. This makes a tradeoff between having fillable queues that can eclipse gossip for a node vs being DOSsed by too many messages. Grandine chose one end of that spectrum

author: potuz
content: tweaking those queues will be a task that will take several months after we ship to mainnet IMO, I wish there was a better way to deal with these issues, but I do not really know how to.
